visual_rules: 각 셀은 같은 카메라 높이와 같은 지형 범위를 유지한다.
프레임 사이에 얇고 일정한 여백을 둔다.
텍스트, 숫자, 화살표, UI, 워터마크를 넣지 않는다.
위쪽 프레임 일부가 아래쪽에 반복되거나 아래쪽 프레임이 위에 붙는 래핑 현상을 허용하지 않는다.
첫 프레임은 초기 조건, 마지막 프레임은 교과서적 완성 지형을 보여준다.

landforms.image_prompt_en: Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of an oxbow lake forming on a broad floodplain: a meandering river migrates laterally, the meander neck narrows, a flood cuts through the neck, and the abandoned loop becomes a crescent-shaped lake. Fixed oblique aerial camera, same landscape extent in all 30 cells, no text, no arrows, no labels, no UI, clean gutters, no cropped or wrapped frames.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of a floodplain and natural levees forming: floodwater spreads from a river, coarse sediment settles near the banks, lower backswamps remain farther away, and raised levees become visible along both sides of the channel. Fixed aerial-oblique view, same scale across all 30 frames, no labels, no arrows, clean gutters, no frame wrapping.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of river terraces forming: a river first builds a floodplain, then base level falls or land uplifts, the river incises downward, and older floodplain surfaces remain as paired step-like terraces. Fixed oblique valley camera, consistent lighting, no labels, no arrows, no text, clean gutters.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of sea caves, sea arches, and sea stacks forming along a rocky coast: waves exploit joints, caves enlarge, an arch opens through a headland, the arch roof collapses, and an isolated sea stack remains offshore. Fixed low oblique coastal camera, no text, no arrows, clean gutters, no cropped frames.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of a wave-cut platform forming: waves erode the base of a sea cliff, the cliff retreats landward, collapsed debris is removed, and a broad flat rock platform is exposed at low tide. Fixed oblique shoreline camera, same scale and horizon in every frame, no labels, no arrows, clean gutters.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of a barrier island forming: longshore drift moves sand, a narrow offshore bar grows parallel to the coast, a lagoon separates it from the mainland, and storm overwash creates subtle breaks and dunes. Fixed aerial coastal camera, no text, no arrows, no UI, clean gutters, no wrapped frames.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of moraines forming: a valley glacier advances, carries rock debris along its sides and base, pauses at its terminus, then retreats and leaves ridges of unsorted till as terminal and lateral moraines. Fixed oblique alpine valley camera, no labels, no arrows, clean gutters.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of drumlins forming beneath an ice sheet: subglacial till is pressed and streamlined by moving ice, elongated teardrop hills align with ice flow, and the drumlin field is exposed after retreat. Fixed aerial-oblique camera, same direction of ice flow, no text, no arrows, clean gutters.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of an esker forming: meltwater flows through a tunnel beneath a glacier, sand and gravel accumulate in the tunnel, the glacier retreats, and a long winding ridge remains on a low plain. Fixed aerial-oblique camera, no text, no arrows, clean gutters, no frame wrapping.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of a maar forming: rising magma meets groundwater, a phreatomagmatic explosion blasts a broad low crater, ejecta forms a low rim, and groundwater fills the crater lake. Fixed oblique volcanic plain camera, no labels, no arrows, no text, clean gutters.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of a lava dome forming: viscous lava extrudes slowly from a volcanic vent, piles up into a steep rounded dome, fractures develop, and small collapse scars appear on the dome flanks. Fixed low oblique volcano camera, no labels, no arrows, clean gutters.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of a polje forming in karst terrain: small dolines and uvalas merge, dissolution enlarges a broad flat-floored basin, underground drainage develops, and seasonal water temporarily floods the basin floor. Fixed aerial-oblique karst camera, no text, no arrows, clean gutters.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of a tidal flat forming on a low-energy coast: broad shallow intertidal flats accumulate fine sediment, tidal channels become more visible, and the surface alternates between wet reflective mud and exposed flats. Fixed aerial oblique camera, no labels, clean gutters.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of marine terraces forming: waves cut a flat platform, the coast uplifts or sea level falls, older shore platforms become steps above the sea, and multiple terraces remain along the coast. Fixed oblique shoreline camera, no text, clean gutters.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of a kettle lake forming: blocks of stagnant ice are buried in outwash, the glacier retreats, buried ice melts, and rounded depressions fill with water. Fixed aerial oblique camera, no labels, clean gutters.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of an outwash plain forming in front of a retreating glacier: meltwater carries sand and gravel, braided streams spread across the forefield, and a broad sorted plain develops. Fixed aerial oblique camera, no labels, clean gutters.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of thermokarst forming: ice-rich permafrost thaws, the ground subsides unevenly, shallow ponds appear, and irregular low basins expand. Fixed aerial oblique tundra camera, no labels, clean gutters.

Create a realistic 5x6 filmstrip of a cinder cone forming: pyroclasts erupt from a small vent, scoria accumulates around the vent, a steep cone grows at the angle of repose, and a central crater remains. Fixed oblique volcanic field camera, no labels, clean gutters.
